# Timothy Cotton

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

## Personality

Timothy Cotton is a member of a family from [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) that relocated to the area. He is characterized by others as shiftless and expected to become a public burden.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)_

## History

Timothy Cotton was a shiftless man living in [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) who suffered from consumption. Known for stealing, he once took a crock of butter from [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) Lynde's dairy and lied to his wife, claiming he had purchased it from her. His family later faced the prospect of moving from [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), with community members anticipating they would become a public burden due to his illness and his wife's unskillfulness.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P2](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0002), [v2 IX A Question of Color P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 IX A Question of Color P4](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0004), [v2 IX A Question of Color P5](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0005), +27 more_
